resources.string: The address of your Zankup: api.zankup.com, your own domain or your Railway address.
No Zankup answered at that address.
Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Enter your e-mail and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
If that e-mail has an account, the link is on its way.
The link opens the web app, where you choose the new password. Then come back here and sign in.
Two-step verification is not set up for this account yet. Set it up with python -m zankup.admin enable-totp.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s s.
That took too long. Enter your password again.

Google sign-in could not start on this phone.
This Google account is not linked to this Zankup. Sign in another way and link it in You → Settings → Account.
This instance has no account yet. It will be yours alone.
It is in the server logs (Railway → Deployments → Logs): "Sign-up is open… setup code: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX".
I understand that my data stays on this instance, which only I run, and that Zankup has no central service.
Add this key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…): open it from here if it is on this phone, or type the key. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
No app on this phone opens the key: type it into your authenticator app instead.
Or type this key into the app:
If you lose your phone, each of these codes replaces the 6-digit code once. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.

Accept how your data is handled to continue.

The fingerprint was not given, so this session will not be kept: next time Zankup asks you to sign in.
